summary: Sua loi lam thi nghiem xac nhan 20 seed sinh phan quyet tu du lieu RONG. LOI GOC: runner doc record objectives nhu DICT (item[objectives][relative_cost], gate bang '"relative_cost" in item[objectives]') trong khi BudgetedEvaluator luu objectives la TUPLE theo thu tu OBJECTIVE_KEYS. Dieu kien do kiem mot CHUOI co nam trong tuple cac SO hay khong nen LUON False. Hau qua do duoc: moi run bao feasible_count 0 va best_cost None, ke ca arm A1 nsga2 la arm ma ta biet chac tim duoc 312-358 phuong an kha thi va cham toi uu vet can 2072.94; archive_size lai 1-4 nen ban ghi TU MAU THUAN; n_paired_seeds 0; va tu do runner van phat bieu phan quyet KHONG DAT (H0 giu vung). Kiem chung trUC tiep: cung mot run nsga2(120, seed 42) cho 0 phuong an kha thi theo cach doc cu va 85 phuong an theo cach doc dung. Day la CUNG LOP LOI voi pymoo_adapter da va o BRD-009. Ngoai ra ket qua da ACCEPTED chi chay 1 seed (n_runs_total 8 = 4 arm x 2 thuat toan x 1 seed) trong khi pre-registration dang ky 20 seed. DA SUA BA THU: (1) doc objectives bang OBJECTIVE_KEYS.index; (2) CAM phat bieu phan quyet khi n_paired_seeds bang 0 hoac duoi nua so seed dang ky - tra ve KHONG KET LUAN DUOC thay vi KHONG DAT, vi khong dat nghia la da kiem va bac bo con day la chua kiem duoc; (3) ghi seeds_registered, seeds_executed va seed_compliance vao summary, in canh bao khi chay lech so seed. Da them 5 test hoi quy chan ca lop loi. Chay thu 2 seed sau khi va: best_cost ra so that va KHOP CHINH XAC voi run A/B truoc (A2 nsga2 seed 42 = 2008.95; A3 nsga2 seed 43 = 2057.71), phan quyet tu choi ket luan dung cach. Da phong chay day du 20 seed o nen.
